stops.scene: At the fountain, 3 ducks are swimming, and 2 more just waddled up to join them.

challenge.prompt: How many ducks are at the fountain now?
hints: Try counting up! Start at 3, then count 2 more.
Three... four... five! How many is that?

stops.scene: Mmm, you smell fresh bread! Baker Bo has a riddle for you before he'll share a treat.

challenge.prompt: I'm fluffy, I say cluck cluck, and I lay the eggs Baker Bo uses for muffins. What am I?
hints: You'd find me in a henhouse on the farm!
I go cluck cluck and I have feathers.

stops.scene: A friendly troll guards the Old Bridge. He says the only way across is to march right over it!

challenge.prompt: Stomp across the troll bridge TEN times, then say 'I made it!'
challenge.waiting_prompt: Take your time, I can hear you stomping!

stops.scene: The trees are whispering a puzzle! A wise owl counted 6 shiny acorns under her tree, then spotted one more.

challenge.prompt: How many acorns did the owl find in all?
hints: One more than 6... what comes right after 6 when you count?
Six... then one more is seven!

stops.scene: The waves are sparkling! A friendly crab pokes out of the sand with one more riddle.

challenge.prompt: I live in the sea, I have eight wiggly arms, and I love to hide in the sand. What am I?
hints: I squirt ink and I'm super squishy!
Count my arms... one, two, three... all the way to eight!

stops.scene: You made it to Treasure Cave! The treasure chest is glowing, but it only opens for a true treasure dance.

challenge.prompt: Spin around three times and shout 'Treasure time!' to open the chest.
challenge.waiting_prompt: I can feel the magic building, keep going!
